protocol.tasks: Controlled English subject-verb agreement and indirect-object identification; this is not a published benchmark-score reproduction.
protocol.objective: Full-vocabulary next-token CE; SVA 0.4 + IOI 0.4 + unrelated WikiText train tokens 0.2.
protocol.model_selection: Lowest mean SVA/IOI validation NLL among checkpoints whose retain NLL rises no more than 0.15 nats.
protocol.validation: New prompt pairs, same template/vocabulary distribution. Retain validation uses even-index validation cache chunks.
protocol.localization: Separate discovery prompts; retain discovery uses odd-index validation cache chunks. Cache chunks are packed token windows, not original articles.
protocol.confirmation: Heldout new prompt pairs; transfer uses disjoint nouns/names and held-out templates.
protocol.rollback: Predictor coefficients interpolate between baseline and adapted predictor, before unchanged local corrections. LoRA rank terms interpolate to zero.
protocol.units: Predictor units are layer/head/source/stream scalar output coordinates at all positions; LoRA units are rank terms. Unit counts are not equivalent circuit sizes.
protocol.controls: Full rollback identity; opposite-task masks; matched-count random units. Dense/MLP neuron analysis is a later stage.
protocol.limits: One training seed; fixed 300M pretrained checkpoint; trainable parameter counts differ; no efficiency superiority claim.
